name: CONTENT-ADMIN-ARTICLE-CATEGORY
status: implemented; tested against local provider fixture; real User integration pending

authorization.flow: verify user JWT and authoritative session for admin scope; GET fixed User /api/admin/auth/me with the same token on every operation; check canonical user.id equals principal and current permission
authorization.rules: No roles imply permissions. Only a listed operation permission or explicit *:*:* grants access; no positive permission cache.
authorization.failure: User or local invalid session 401; scope or missing permission 403; authority unavailable, malformed response or subject mismatch 503 with business code 500
authorization.connection: KNODE_USER_ORIGIN fixed HTTPS origin, or literal loopback HTTP for development; no proxy, redirects or retry; connect 400ms; GET deadline 1000ms; response max 3145728 bytes
authorization.limits: roles and permissions each <=1000 distinct strings <=128 characters; empty permissions grant nothing; subject must be canonical positive signed int64 decimal string
authorization.privacy: Do not log or return User token, email or raw upstream body.

semantics.admin: An explicitly authorized administrator can manage other authors. Author, original creation time and first-publication identity remain unchanged; updatedBy derives from admin principal. isTop is 0 or 1. Blog create still forces isTop 0.
semantics.batchDelete: At most 100 positive signed int64 IDs; deduplicate, lock in ascending order, and delete all in one transaction. Missing or already deleted item rolls back entire batch.
semantics.list: Includes drafts, excludes deleted. pageNum default 1, pageSize default 10 and max 100, max offset 10000000. title and summary LIKE treats !, % and underscore literally with parameterized queries. Stable createdAt/id descending; list omits content.
semantics.category: list includes all extant categories; listAllCategory returns active categories even without published articles.
semantics.serialization: Long IDs, viewCount and total are decimal strings; dates yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss GMT+8; successful writes return only code/msg.
semantics.errors: Invalid article fields HTTP 200/code 514; not found HTTP 200/code 513; malformed JSON HTTP 400/code 400; system failure HTTP 500/code 500; authentication and authority errors use real HTTP statuses.

events.status: candidate; no production relay or consumer integration
events.publicPayloadAddition: isTop is a string 0/1. New public facts use schemaVersion 2; existing v1 rows are untouched. Consumers must review and support both versions before delivery.
events.firstPublication: stable publicationFactId and first publishedAt survive later edit, withdrawal and republication; old payloads stay immutable

deferred: global event and permission seed approval
